errors.date: Each payment needs a valid date.
errors.over_received: The sum goes over what was received. Lower the amount or split less.

bishop.empty: Once you sign a tripartite contract, you will see the program amount and your payments here.
bishop.read_only: Read only. Strategic Mates records the payments and splits the funds among the firms.

validation.email_invalid: Check the email. It should look like this: name@company.com.
validation.password_short: The password needs at least {{min}} characters.
validation.password_mismatch: The two passwords are not the same. Type them again.
validation.terms_required: To create your account, tick that you accept the terms.

password_hint.ok: Long enough. Mixing letters, numbers and symbols makes it safer.

errors.invalid_credentials: The email or the password do not match
errors.invalid_credentials_help: Check that they are spelled right. If you do not remember your password, you can change it or sign in with a link by email.
errors.account_inactive_help: Talk to your Strategic Mates consultant to turn it back on.
errors.generic: We could not finish this step
errors.generic_help: Check your internet connection and try again.

token.invalid_help: Check that the link is complete. If you copied it, copy the whole link from the email.

login.title: Sign in to your portal
login.subtitle: Use the email Strategic Mates invited you with.
login.use_magic: Sign in with a link by email
login.demo_hint: Demo: every test account uses the password {{password}}
login.reset_done: Done, your password is changed. Sign in with the new one.
login.two_factor_enabled: Done. Sign in again with your password and the code.
login.two_factor_restart_help: For your security, the code step expired. Type your email and password again.

magic.title: Sign in with a link
magic.subtitle: We send a link to your email. You open it and you are in, no password.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.body: If <email>{{email}}</email> has an account, we sent a link to sign in.
sent.body_no_email: If your email has an account, we sent a link to sign in.
sent.rules: The link works once and expires in 15 minutes.
sent.spam: Did not get it? Look in the spam folder or ask for another link.

magic_exchange.help: Sign-in links last 15 minutes and work once. Ask for a new one and you will get another email.
magic_exchange.inactive_help: Your account is deactivated. Talk to your Strategic Mates consultant.

invitation.title: Create your account
invitation.intro: {{inviter}} invited you to the Strategic Mates portal.
invitation.intro_no_inviter: Strategic Mates invited you to its portal.
invitation.terms: I accept the <terms>terms</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>
invitation.expired_body: Invitations last 7 days. Ask for a new one and you will get another email.
invitation.used_body: You already created your account with this link. Sign in with your email and password.
invitation.invalid_title: We could not find this invitation
invitation.request_new_note: Write to your Strategic Mates consultant and ask for a new invitation. It will arrive by email.

forgot.title: Change your password
forgot.subtitle: Type your email. We send you instructions to create a new password.
forgot.done_body: If <email>{{email}}</email> has an account, we sent you instructions. The link expires in 1 hour.

reset.title: Create a new password
reset.subtitle: After this you sign in with this password.
reset.help: Password links last 1 hour and work once. Ask for a new one.

logout.error: We could not sign you out. Try again.

two_factor.title: Type your code
two_factor.subtitle: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code you see for Strategic Mates.
two_factor.code_hint: The code changes every 30 seconds in the app. Type the one you see now.
two_factor.code_required: Type the {{digits}} digits of the code.
two_factor.use_app: Use the code from the app
two_factor.recovery_subtitle: Type one of the codes you saved when you turned on two-step verification.
two_factor.invalid_code_help: Check that it is the one you see now in the app. If it changed, type the new one.
two_factor.invalid_recovery_help: Check that it is typed right. If you already used that code, try another one.
two_factor.challenge_help: For your security, the code is asked for a few minutes after you type your password. Sign in again with your email and password.
two_factor.missing_title: First sign in with your email
two_factor.missing_body: To ask for your code, we first need your email and password.

two_factor_setup.title: Turn on two-step verification
two_factor_setup.subtitle: Besides your password, when you sign in we will ask for a code from your phone. That way nobody else can get into your account.
two_factor_setup.required_note: Your account needs this step to enter the portal. When you sign in, besides your password, we will ask for a code from your phone.
two_factor_setup.step_app_title: Add your account in the app
two_factor_setup.step_app_body: Open your authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator) and add a new account with this key.
two_factor_setup.open_app_hint: If you are on your phone, this link opens the app with the key already filled in.
two_factor_setup.step_code_title: Type the code the app shows you
two_factor_setup.codes_body: If one day you do not have your phone, you can sign in with one of these codes. Each one works only once. We will not show them again.
two_factor_setup.copied: You copied the codes. Paste them somewhere safe.
two_factor_setup.copy_failed: We could not copy them. Select them and copy them by hand.
two_factor_setup.token_invalid_body: Sign in again with your email and password to start over.
two_factor_setup.already_enabled: You already have two-step verification on.

entry_link.title: Your intake
entry_link.help: Entry links work once and have an expiration date. Ask for a new link and you will get another email.
